question: Should `submitText` become the permanent shared public result for plugin interactive handlers, with supporting channels implementing source-bound submission and unsupported channels ignoring it?
rationale: The change is additive and follows Telegram's existing behavior, but it turns a channel-specific feature into a public cross-channel SDK promise whose capability and compatibility semantics cannot be settled by tests alone.

options.title: Approve the shared result
options.body: Adopt the additive shared field after the branch is refreshed, checks pass, and live Discord source-routing proof is posted.

options.title: Keep channel-specific results
options.body: Request a narrower Discord-owned result contract or close the PR if maintainers do not want a cross-channel SDK promise.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared result
recommendation.body: Adopt the additive shared field after the branch is refreshed, checks pass, and live Discord source-routing proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice governs the permanent public plugin SDK contract rather than a mechanical Discord implementation detail.
